result.note: Trade remedy story; tests the history of the duties and how the rates are set, not company names.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, China extended anti-dumping duties on Indian single-mode optical fibre for another five years. Consider the following statements:
items: China first imposed these duties in 2014 and previously renewed them for five years in 2020.
The extended duties apply at a single uniform rate to all Indian exporters.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the rates differ by exporter, ranging from 7.4 percent to 30.6 percent. China's Ministry of Commerce said a year-long expiry review found that removing the duties could allow dumping and harm to domestic producers to continue or recur.
questions.source: China first imposed the measures in 2014 and previously renewed them for five years in 2020.
